text: Dream: sampled batch acceptance keeps human authority while draining the review queue
description: The human reviews a random sample of k ideas from a batch in review. If every sample passes, one explicit click accepts the whole batch; if any fails, the batch goes back. The per-agent acceptance rate becomes a reliability estimate that sets k. Smallest experiment: Felix samples 10 of the review queue by hand and records how many pass. Disconfirming: sampled failure rate above ~10%.
